name: write-through-projection
body:
The write-through projection — SUPERSEDES the write-back/batched buffer model (`solution.component.derived-projection-buffer`, removed). Every completed mutation applies its exact node/edge delta to `apg/.trans/db.lbug` synchronously as part of the mutation: the durable file write + git commit first (commit-then-project), then the delta — with no accumulation, no deferred flush, and no session-end dependency.

When a session is live the coordinator applies each routed mutation's delta through this component before acknowledging; the direct path applies it inline. Amortization keeps one DB open/parse across the session but never defers visibility: `coordinator-amortized-flush` is amortization of the open, not batching of visibility.

It anchors to the real synchronous write paths — `apg.layers.write_project` (durable node/edge path) and `apg.plan_cmd.write_through` (transient plan/feedback path) — and to `solution.component.projection-delta-applier` for the exact-delta deletion semantics. New session code (a synchronous apply inside `apg.session.Coordinator`) is declared by the plan as planned nodes. (Not yet built — planned code.)
